sources.entry: Wagtail - Django content management system focused on flexibility and user experience. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Python
wagtail - A Django content management system.

summary.one_liner: Wagtail is an open-source content management system built on Django, focused on editor experience and giving developers precise control over front-end design.
summary.what_it_does: Wagtail is a CMS built on the Django web framework and released under the BSD license. It provides an authoring interface for editors and lets developers control front-end templates and page structure. Its StreamField feature supports flexible page content while keeping it structured. It includes built-in search that can use Elasticsearch or PostgreSQL, along with image and embedded-content handling. The README also mentions a Content API for headless sites with decoupled front-ends, plus multi-site and multi-language support. Installation is via pip with a `wagtail start` project generator.
use_cases: building a company or organisation website with a Django backend
giving non-technical editors a web interface to publish pages
running a headless CMS with a separate front-end
adding a CMS to an existing Django project
notable: StreamField for flexible yet structured page content
Content API for headless, decoupled front-ends
Built-in search using Elasticsearch or PostgreSQL
Feature releases every three months with designated LTS releases
caveats: Supports only specific Django and Python versions; older Python 2.7 and earlier Django versions are no longer supported
Commercial support and hosting help is offered by Torchbox as a paid service
